# Build & Infrastructure Readiness Checklist: AWS Hybrid Recommendation Platform

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality, completeness, clarity, architectural consistency, and governance constraints across all 11 AWS services, data contracts, and implementation modules prior to task execution.  
**Created**: 2026-11-04  
**Feature**: [Feature Specification](../spec.md) | [Implementation Plan](../plan.md) | [Project Constitution](../../.specify/memory/constitution.md) | [Handover Context](../../SESSION_HANDOVER.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Infrastructure as Code & Cost-Control Governance (Principles I & V)

- [ ] CHK001 Are declarative Terraform module requirements defined for all 11 AWS services without console-only manual steps? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context, Constitution Principle V]
- [ ] CHK002 Are ephemeral lifecycle requirements (automated `terraform apply` and `terraform destroy` workflows in GitHub Actions) explicitly specified to prevent runaway idle costs? [Clarity, Plan §Constitution Check, Handover §2]
- [ ] CHK003 Are S3 bucket destruction requirements explicitly parameterized with `force_destroy = true` to prevent teardown failures from non-empty buckets? [Consistency, Constitution Principle V, Quickstart §3]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the scheduling and suspension mechanism for the highest-cost component (Amazon MWAA, 71.2% / $447.90/mo baseline) unambiguously documented with ephemeral runtime controls? [Clarity, Handover §2, Spec §Feature 2.1]
- [ ] CHK005 Are PoC compute SKUs explicitly constrained to minimum-cost options (ECS Fargate Spot 0.5 vCPU/1 GB, MemoryDB 1 shard `db.t4g.small` with 0 replicas, and SageMaker Serverless Inference at $0 idle)? [Completeness, Constitution Principle I, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the permanent Free Tier boundary for Amazon DynamoDB (`PAY_PER_REQUEST`, <25 GB storage) documented as an immutable constraint in infrastructure specifications? [Traceability, Constitution Principle I, Handover §2]

## 2. Storage Schemas & Inter-Service Data Contracts

- [ ] CHK007 Are the Apache Parquet storage layout, Snappy compression settings, and `year/month/day` partitioning strategy for the S3 Golden Dataset completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §Feature 1.1, Data-Model §2]
- [ ] CHK008 Are AWS Lake Formation governance requirements (LF-Tags, table registrations, and PII masking rules) defined with testable access policies? [Clarity, Spec §Feature 1.2, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK009 Does the DynamoDB `user_recommendations` contract specify key schemas (`userId` Partition Key), JSON attribute definitions, and the 7-day TTL attribute format? [Completeness, Contract: dynamodb-batch-recs-contract.json, Data-Model §2]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the Amazon MemoryDB Redis 7.1+ vector schema, HNSW distance metric (COSINE), vector dimensionality (128-dim FLOAT32), and `FT.SEARCH` query syntax fully documented? [Consistency, Contract: memorydb-vector-contract.md, Research §Decision 2]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the input and output JSON payload schema for SageMaker Serverless Inference explicitly defined with candidate array schemas and numeric scoring bounds [0.0, 1.0]? [Completeness, Contract: sagemaker-inference-contract.json, Spec §Feature 3.2]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the OpenAPI 3.0 specification (`recommendations-api.yaml`) define all query parameters (`userId`, `limit`, `categoryFilter`), HTTP status codes (200, 400, 500), and response headers? [Completeness, Contract: recommendations-api.yaml, Spec §Feature 4.1]

## 3. Serving Microservice & Clean Architecture Modularity (Principle II)

- [ ] CHK013 Are Clean Architecture boundaries strictly documented to isolate domain logic (`domain/`) from AWS SDK clients (`infrastructure/`) to allow local mock execution? [Clarity, Constitution Principle II, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK014 Are ECS Fargate Spot task sizing, Application Load Balancer listener rules, and Fastify health check endpoints (`GET /health`) defined with measurable criteria? [Completeness, Spec §Feature 4.1, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the local emulation requirements (DynamoDB Local, Redis Stack container) documented with reproducible configuration parameters for offline development? [Coverage, Quickstart §2, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the Node.js 20 LTS and TypeScript 5.4+ build toolchain, Fastify v4 framework choice, and packaging configuration specified without missing tool dependencies? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context]

## 4. Execution Flow, Candidate Merging & Business Filtering

- [ ] CHK017 Is the 7-step Request Execution Flow specified with explicit parallel execution semantics for DynamoDB and MemoryDB retrieval? [Clarity, Spec §Executive Summary, Constitution Principle III]
- [ ] CHK018 Are candidate merging rules and deduplication conflict-resolution criteria specified when an item appears in both batch and realtime candidate pools? [Clarity, Spec §Feature 4.4, Data-Model §3]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the provenance tagging rules (`batch`, `realtime`, `hybrid`) unambiguously documented for every returned recommendation item? [Consistency, Spec §Feature 4.4, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK020 Are business filtering rules explicitly defined to guarantee 100% suppression of out-of-stock items, purchase history within a 30-day window, and geo-restricted catalog items? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Feature 4.5, Constitution Principle III]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the final reranking and candidate scoring formula documented with explicit priority order (User relevance > Model score > Semantic similarity > Business diversity)? [Clarity, Spec §Feature 4.6, Constitution Principle III]

## 5. Operational Resilience & Edge-Case Degradation (Principles III & IV)

- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for Edge Case 1: Normal healthy hybrid execution returning Top-N items tagged `hybrid`? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Quickstart §4]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for Edge Case 2: SageMaker Serverless Inference timeout (>35ms) or 5xx triggering in-memory heuristic reranking without client-visible 500 errors? [Edge Case, Spec §Feature 4.6, Resilience Matrix]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for Edge Case 3: Amazon MemoryDB vector store unreachable or connection timeout falling back to pure DynamoDB batch candidates? [Edge Case, Spec §Feature 4.3, Handover §1]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for Edge Case 4: Cold-start or missing DynamoDB batch profile falling back to real-time semantic vector retrieval and online scoring? [Edge Case, Spec §Feature 4.2, Constitution Principle III]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for Edge Case 5: Complete downstream outage falling back to static curated/trending recommendations with `degradedMode: true` and 200 OK? [Resilience, Spec §Graceful Fallback Strategy, Constitution Principle IV]
- [ ] CHK027 Does the specification mandate circuit breaker settings (`opossum`) with explicit threshold percentages, reset timeout durations, and half-open state rules? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context, Spec §Feature 4.1]

## 6. Non-Functional Requirements & Observability (Principle IV)

- [ ] CHK028 Are end-to-end API response time thresholds (<60ms P95 at 500 RPS) and sub-component latency budgets (DynamoDB <5ms, MemoryDB <10ms, SageMaker <20ms, in-memory <3ms) objectively measurable? [Measurability, Plan §Technical Context, Spec §NFR-1]
- [ ] CHK029 Are structured JSON logging requirements (correlation ID, per-stage execution durations, fallback trigger flags, and candidate counts before/after filtering) fully specified? [Clarity, Spec §Feature 5.4, Constitution Principle IV]
- [ ] CHK030 Are CloudWatch operational metric definitions (error rates, P95/P99 latencies, cache hit ratios, and fallback invocations) and alarm SNS notification rules documented? [Completeness, Spec §Feature 5.1 & 5.2]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the CloudWatch log group retention policy explicitly capped at 14 days to prevent storage accumulation costs? [Consistency, Constitution Principle I, Handover §2]

## 7. Traceability, Assumptions & Governance Gaps

- [ ] CHK032 Are all 23 features across Epics 1 through 5 mapped to corresponding source code directories and testing harnesses? [Traceability, Plan §Project Structure, Spec §Features]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the assumption that AWS Glue 4.0 Job Bookmarks prevent redundant batch reprocessing documented and validated? [Assumption, Spec §Feature 2.3, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the cold-start behavior for anonymous/unauthenticated sessions versus recognized users with zero purchase history clearly distinguished? [Ambiguity, Spec §Feature 4.1, Data-Model §Entity 1]
- [ ] CHK035 Are the fallback recommendations dataset schema and packaging strategy (bundled in container vs. S3 read) clearly specified for the worst-case outage scenario? [Gap, Spec §Graceful Fallback Strategy]
- [ ] CHK036 Is a clean transition path to `/speckit-tasks` defined so that all approved requirements and edge cases translate directly into dependency-ordered implementation tasks? [Completeness, Handover §5, Plan §Summary]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline for any identified gaps before running implementation tasks.
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK036) for cross-referencing in pull requests and design reviews.
